feedback.problem: What is the domain in the $xy$-plane of the parabolic cylinder ${x}^{2}=-5(y+1)?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The full expression describing all points on our parabolic cylinder is

$$
{x}^{2}=-5(y+1),\,z=k
$$

where $k\in R$ can vary arbitrarily. 

The domain of any cylinder in the $xy$-plane is its base curve. Hence, in this case, the domain is

$$
{(x,y)\in {R}^{2}:{x}^{2}=-5(y+1)}.
$$

This is a downward-opening parabola with a vertex at $(0,-1).$

submitted_fields.submitted_value: A downward-opening parabola with a vertex at $(0,-1)$
